name: Business Current Account Opening — Service Boundaries
description: Maps data model entities to owning service capabilities for JRN-004. Each service boundary section defines: owned entities, consumed APIs (synchronous inter-service calls), published events, and consumed events. JRN-004 introduces SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core) as a new service and extends SVC-014 (KYC/AML) and SVC-050 (Customer Onboarding) with commercial-specific extensions. Cross-capability communication is via async events only. All synchronous dependencies are intra-capability or to shared compliance services.
architectural_principles: Single ownership: every entity is owned by exactly one service. BusinessCustomer is owned by SVC-005 (CAP-002), not SVC-001 (CAP-001). No shared entities between commercial and retail capabilities.

Capabilities as deployment boundary: SVC-005 is the unit of deployment for all CAP-002 commercial banking core entities. SVC-014 and SVC-050 serve both retail (JRN-001) and commercial (JRN-004) journeys but maintain separate entity types per journey.
Share contracts not implementations: all cross-capability access via API contracts or event bus (SVC-102). SVC-005 never reads SVC-001 databases; SVC-001 never reads SVC-005 databases.

Event-driven state propagation: domain events on SVC-102 are the cross-capability communication mechanism. SVC-005 publishes commercial events; SVC-014 and SVC-050 subscribe and publish compliance events back.

Compliance services (SVC-014, SVC-050, SVC-051) are hard blocking dependencies: BusinessAccount provisioning cannot proceed without BusinessKYCCleared; BusinessKYCCleared cannot be granted without all UBO/director individual verifications complete and sanctions-clear.
Companies House API is an external dependency of SVC-005 only — no other service calls the CH API directly. CH data is owned by SVC-005 and distributed to SVC-014 via events.

owned_entities.ownership_rationale: SVC-005 is the authoritative commercial ledger. BusinessCustomer is the aggregate root for all commercial banking relationships. All downstream commercial journeys (loans, trade finance, merchant services) reference the business identity from SVC-005. Completely separate from SVC-001's ENT-001 Customer — different capability domain, different regulatory regime, different data model.

SVC-005 is the commercial ledger; BusinessAccount is the commercial account record. Account creation (sort code/account number allocation, multi-signatory configuration, payment rail enablement) must be atomic within SVC-005. The commercial and retail ledgers are separate — distinct sort code ranges, distinct account number sequences.

UBO identification is a business relationship attribute — who owns this business entity? This is co-located with BusinessCustomer in SVC-005 because UBO data is part of the business identity aggregate. SVC-014 reads UBO screening results via event payload; it does not own the UBO record.

Director records are sourced from Companies House via SVC-005 (the only service that calls the CH API). Co-locating DirectorRecord in SVC-005 with BusinessCustomer ensures Companies House reconciliation and director lifecycle management (appointment, resignation) is handled in one service.

external_system_dependencies.auth_method: API key (stored in secrets management, rotated quarterly)
external_system_dependencies.async_fallback: If CH API exceeds 8,000ms, request is moved to async retry queue. Application continues in held state. PER-002 notified if delay exceeds 30 minutes.
external_system_dependencies.notes: SVC-005 is the sole caller of the Companies House API. CH data is distributed to other services via domain events (CompaniesHouseVerified payload carries company details, director list summary, and PSC list summary).

consumed_apis.api_description: SVC-005 consumes the BusinessKYCCleared event from SVC-014 to trigger BusinessApplicationDecisionMade. This is async event-driven — SVC-005 does not poll SVC-014.
consumed_apis.governance_note: MLR 2017 Regulation 28: no business relationship may be established before CDD is complete. BusinessKYCCleared is the technical enforcement of this obligation.

consumed_apis.api_description: SVC-005 calls SVC-100 for business portal authentication in BPH-008 onwards.
consumed_apis.governance_note: PSR 2017 Regulation 100 SCA compliance: business portal access gated by SCA-compliant authentication.

published_events.trigger: PER-002 submits business account application at BPH-001. BusinessCustomer (prospect) and BusinessApplicationRecord created.
published_events.payload_summary: application_id, business_customer_id, company_number, entity_type, channel, started_at

published_events.trigger: CH API returns company record and SVC-005 successfully reconciles it with applicant data at BPH-002.
published_events.payload_summary: application_id, business_customer_id, company_number, legal_name, company_status, incorporation_date, sic_codes, director_count, ubo_count_from_psc

published_events.trigger: Each UltimateBeneficialOwner entity is created and confirmed by applicant at BPH-003. One event per UBO.
published_events.payload_summary: ubo_id, business_customer_id, ubo_first_name, ubo_last_name, ownership_percentage, control_type, verification_invitation_sent

published_events.trigger: SVC-050 confirms identity verification passed for a director or UBO individual. Published per individual.
published_events.note: SVC-005 subscribes to DirectorVerified to update verification_status on DirectorRecord and UltimateBeneficialOwner entities.

published_events.trigger: Decision engine produces outcome at BPH-006.

published_events.payload_summary: business_account_id, business_customer_id, account_number, sort_code, iban, bic, account_type, opened_date, fscs_eligible

published_events.trigger: BusinessAccount.status transitions to active and multi-signatory configuration is written at BPH-007.
published_events.payload_summary: business_account_id, business_customer_id, status: active, payment_approval_threshold, authorised_users_count, payment_rails_enabled, provisioned_at

consumed_events.purpose: SVC-005 receives DirectorVerified to update DirectorRecord.verification_status and UltimateBeneficialOwner.verification_status. Tracks completeness of all required verifications before BPH-005 can proceed.
Gates BPH-006 account decision. SVC-005 will not run the decision engine without BusinessKYCCleared. On receipt, SVC-005 triggers the automated decision engine.
Transitions BusinessApplicationRecord.status to 'referred'. Suspends account decisioning pending MLRO/EDD resolution.
Immediately blocks BusinessApplicationRecord — transitions status to 'blocked'. No further processing until MLRO resolution.

owned_entities_detail.ownership_rationale: Mirrors the JRN-001 design: MLRO accountability under POCA 2002 and MLR 2017 requires a single system of record for CDD assessments under MLRO governance. SVC-014 owns both personal (ENT-003) and business (ENT-B005) CDD assessments. Business CDD adds company-level screening, sector risk, jurisdictional risk, and aggregated UBO/director individual assessments.

service_boundaries.jrn004_extensions: JRN-004 extends SVC-014 with the capability to: (1) receive UBOIdentified and CompaniesHouseVerified events and construct the full business ownership structure for screening; (2) run concurrent PEP/sanctions/adverse media screening across multiple individuals (fan-out); (3) aggregate individual screening results into a BusinessKycAssessment with company-level risk scoring; (4) apply sector risk and jurisdictional risk scoring; (5) determine EDD trigger conditions for legal entities.

published_events.trigger: All UBO/director individual screenings complete with no sanctions hits; company-level CDD complete; risk_category = standard or standard_elevated (EDD not required). Or: EDD completed and MLRO has signed off.
published_events.payload_summary: assessment_id, business_customer_id, risk_category, edd_required: false, next_review_date, cleared_at

published_events.trigger: risk_category = enhanced, or any UBO/director PEP match, or high_risk_jurisdiction_flag = true. EDD path triggered.
published_events.payload_summary: assessment_id, business_customer_id, edd_required: true, edd_trigger_reasons, referral_at

published_events.trigger: SVC-051 returns sanctions match (status = blocked) for company, any director, or any UBO.
published_events.payload_summary: assessment_id, business_customer_id, hit_entity_type (company|director|ubo), hit_entity_id, lists_matched, detected_at

consumed_events.purpose: SVC-014 receives company details (legal name, SIC codes, incorporation date, jurisdictions) as CDD inputs for company-level screening.
SVC-014 receives UBO details to prepare for individual-level screening. Builds the screening queue for BPH-005.
SVC-014 receives verified identity data (name, DOB, nationality) for each individual to run PEP/sanctions/adverse media screening.
Initiates ongoing pKYC monitoring for the BusinessCustomer entity — adverse media and sanctions list monitoring activated.

consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-014 calls SVC-051 for each entity (company + each director + each UBO) as a parallel fan-out. Hard limit: 3,000ms per call (GOV-005-R02).

service_boundaries.jrn004_extensions: JRN-004 extends SVC-050 with the capability to: (1) manage multiple concurrent identity verification sessions per application (one per director and UBO, up to 10 per application); (2) dispatch secure verification invitation emails to individuals who are not the primary applicant; (3) track overall verification completeness per business_application_id; (4) publish DirectorVerified (rather than IdentityVerificationCompleted) for business-context individual verifications. The underlying verification mechanism (Onfido/Jumio document + biometric check) is identical to JRN-001.
service_boundaries.jrn004_identity_verification_pattern: For JRN-004, each IdentityVerification record references both a verification_id (UUID) and a context: { business_application_id, individual_type (director|ubo), individual_entity_id (director_id or ubo_id) }. This context is added to the ENT-002 schema as an optional commercial context object — retail verifications (JRN-001) do not have this context. SVC-050 uses the context to route DirectorVerified events to SVC-014 and SVC-005 with the correct entity references.

published_events.trigger: Identity verification vendor returns outcome = pass for a director or UBO individual. One event per individual.
published_events.payload_summary: verification_id, business_customer_id, business_application_id, individual_type (director|ubo), individual_entity_id, document_type, verification_provider, outcome: pass, verified_name, verified_dob, verified_nationality, verified_at
published_events.note: Carries verified identity data (name, DOB, nationality) as CDD inputs for SVC-014. This mirrors the IdentityVerificationCompleted event pattern in JRN-001.

consumed_events.purpose: SVC-050 initialises the business onboarding case. No identity verification sessions are created at this point — sessions are created per individual after BPH-003 UBO identification completes.

SVC-050 creates an identity verification session for each UBO and dispatches the secure invitation email. Primary applicant's session is created immediately; other individuals receive invitation links.

service_boundaries.jrn004_role: SVC-017 orchestrates the business portal UI experience across BPH-001 through BPH-008. It renders the business application form, Companies House verification confirmation, UBO identification UI, verification status dashboard, KYC waiting state, account decision notification, account details confirmation, and business portal setup. Business portal setup includes role-based access control for authorised users and the payment approval workflow configuration UI.
service_boundaries.jrn004_new_capabilities: Business portal enrollment (distinct from personal banking portal enrollment): multi-user access, payment approval workflow configuration, authorised user invitation management. SVC-017 calls SVC-100 to create separate FIDO2/WebAuthn credentials for each authorised business portal user.

published_events.trigger: Primary applicant completes credential setup and first login with biometric SCA for the business portal at BPH-008.
published_events.payload_summary: business_customer_id, business_account_id, primary_user_id, sca_enrolled: true, activated_at

cross_service_interaction_summary.description: End-to-end event and API flow across service boundaries for the JRN-004 happy path (limited company, standard CDD, no EDD).

interaction_sequence.description: PER-002 submits business application. SVC-017 calls SVC-005 to create BusinessCustomer (prospect) and BusinessApplicationRecord. SVC-005 publishes BusinessApplicationStarted (EVT-B001).
SVC-005 calls Companies House API to verify the company. DirectorRecord and UBO staging entities created from PSC/officer data. SVC-005 publishes CompaniesHouseVerified (EVT-B002).

PER-002 confirms UBO list in SVC-017 UI. SVC-005 creates UltimateBeneficialOwner entities. SVC-005 publishes UBOIdentified (EVT-B003) per UBO. SVC-050 receives UBOIdentified events and creates individual identity verification sessions; dispatches invitation emails.

Each director/UBO completes identity verification via Onfido/Jumio (triggered by SVC-050 sessions). SVC-050 creates IdentityVerification entities. SVC-050 publishes DirectorVerified (EVT-B004) per individual. SVC-005 updates DirectorRecord/UBO verification_status. SVC-014 queues each individual for CDD screening on receipt of DirectorVerified.

SVC-014 runs company-level CDD (calls SVC-051 for company sanctions screening) and individual-level CDD (calls SVC-051 for each director/UBO as parallel fan-out). PEP and adverse media screening runs for all individuals. BusinessKycAssessment created. SVC-014 publishes BusinessKYCCleared (EVT-B005).
SVC-005 receives BusinessKYCCleared. Automated decision engine approves. SVC-005 publishes BusinessApplicationDecisionMade (EVT-B006, outcome: approved).

SVC-005 creates BusinessAccount (sort code/account number allocated). BusinessCustomer.status promoted to active. SVC-005 publishes BusinessAccountOpened (EVT-B007) and BusinessAccountProvisioned (EVT-B008).

SVC-017 receives BusinessAccountProvisioned. Guides PER-002 through business portal credential creation (calls SVC-100). Business portal activated. SVC-017 publishes BusinessDigitalChannelActivated (EVT-B009). Welcome communications dispatched via SVC-053.
